description: Free-text accommodation search on noclegowo.pl (Poland), kept for compatibility with the earlier version of the app: takes one message and an optional conversation_id and returns offers with rating, availability, stay price and link.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID from a previous response; absent on the first turn.

message.description: The accommodation request in the user's language (place, dates, guests, wishes) — no personal data.

name: searchAccommodations

conversation_id.description: Opaque id of this search; accepted as conversation_id on a follow-up.

availability.description: available / unavailable for the requested dates; unknown = host confirms on inquiry; not_checked = no dates given or not verified.

nearby.description: Present on an alternative from a neighbouring locality, included because few offers were available in the requested place for these dates; the offer is not in the requested place.

distance_km.description: Distance from the centre of the requested location, km.

from.description: The requested location this offer is near.

price_from_pln.description: Indicative "from" nightly rate from the listing price list; per person or per property depending on the listing. Not the price for specific dates.

anyOf.description: Date-specific quote from the availability check, for the requested dates and party.

indicative.description: True when the total is plausible but not backed by the host's calendar, so it is an indicative price to be confirmed with the host.

total.description: Total for the whole stay and the whole party, PLN.

stay_price_withheld.description: Set when the offer is available but the booking system quoted a total that failed plausibility checks; total_price_pln and stay_price are then null and the price for the dates is to be confirmed with the host.

total_price_pln.description: Same as stay_price.total; null without a quote.

url.description: Offer page on noclegowo.pl (the URL carries attribution parameters).

questions.description: When status=needs_more_info: the information missing for a search.

title: Search accommodation (legacy)
